name: Cloud Autosave
description: Automatically saves your Geometry Dash account to the official servers (same as the Save button in the account menu).

save-on-new-best.name: Save on new best
save-on-new-best.description: Save your account after a new best. The save happens when you pause or leave the level, never during gameplay.

save-on-stat-change.name: Save when account stats change
save-on-stat-change.description: Save when stars, moons, demons, secret coins, user coins or diamonds change (for example after completing a level). Only happens when you are not playing.

cooldown.name: Minimum time between saves (seconds)
cooldown.description: Minimum time between two saves. Everything that happens during this time is merged into one later save.

show-notifications.name: Show notifications
show-notifications.description: Show a notification when a save succeeds or fails.
